dataset.title: Oxford Battery Degradation Dataset 1
dataset.license: ODbL1.0 + DBCL as stated in official readme

duplicate_scope: Exact binary values of v,q,T; excludes timestamps; no approximate duplicates or biological independence claim.
baseline_scope: leave-one-cell-out; train points cycle>=1000; features initial C1dc capacity and cycle; target C1dc capacity magnitude
blocker: No sourced recalibration error/utility/scheduling contract; residuals do not establish scientific difficulty; eight physical cells only.
